stimulus:
Welcome to the experiment!

Press any key to begin.

You will now play several rounds of a game.

You will be given a starting pool of 8000 points and your goal is to avoid losing points during the rounds.

Please press the zero (0) key to continue.

Your points will be converted to a final bonus of $1 per every 2000 points, so please do your best.

You can earn a maximum bonus of $4 at the end of these rounds.

Please press the zero (0) key to continue.

In this game, you will see three kinds of animals. On each turn you will pick one of them.

You can select an animal using the 1, 2, or 3 keys on your keyboard to pick the left, middle, or right animal respectively.

Let's practice selecting an animal.

Pick the left animal by pressing the 1 key.
Great! Now pick the middle animal by pressing the 2 key.
Excellent! Now pick the right animal by pressing the 3 key.

Good job! You have successfully practiced selecting animals.

Some animals lead to a better outcome than others.

An animal can either take away -50 points or allow you to keep points.

Below you can see what those outcomes look like:

;

Please press the zero (0) key to continue.

Your job is to figure out which animal is the best choice, so that you can keep as many points as possible.

Your remaining points will be converted to a final bonus of $1 per every 2000 points at the end of the game.

Please press the zero (0) key to continue.

However, there is one final catch:

There may be times when the best animal will change!

If you think the best animal has changed from what it was before, then try to find out the new best animal to avoid losing points.

Please press the zero (0) key to continue.

The following is a practice round of just 3 turns.

The points you get here won’t change your final score, and the best animal will change between the practice round and when the real game starts.

Please press the zero (0) key to start the practice round.

You will now begin the main task, which will take approximately 10 minutes.

You will be given 8000 points and should attempt to retain points as you select animals.

As a reminder, your remaining points will be converted to a final bonus of $1 per every 2000 points at the end of the game.

Please press the zero (0) key whenever you are ready to start the task.
